title: prisma migrate reset
description: Use prisma migrate reset to wipe the database and reapply all migrations during development.

data.text: `prisma migrate reset` drops the entire database, re-runs all migrations from scratch, and applies the seed script. It is useful during development when you want a clean slate.

items: You have made significant schema changes and want to start fresh
You need to verify that all migrations apply cleanly from scratch
You want to reseed the database with fresh data

data.title: Reset the Database
data.content: Drop and reapply all migrations with a seed.

data.text: By default, `prisma migrate reset` prompts for confirmation. Use the `--force` flag to skip the prompt in scripts.

data.title: Danger
data.text: `prisma migrate reset` permanently deletes all data in the database. Never run it in production or on a shared database.
